definition: Infer.NET is a free and open source .NET software library for machine learning.
details: It supports running Bayesian inference in graphical models and can also be used for probabilistic programming.
story: Think of a lightbulb moment: the idea was always there, but someone had to point a finger at it. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. Once you see it, you cannot unsee it. That is Infer.NET — a small key that opens a big door.
